headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a crucial 8-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Grant Taylor earning the win. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Philadelphia Phillies 11-7, with Brandon Marsh leading the Phillies' offense with 2 home runs and 2 RBIs. The Detroit Tigers also secured a win, defeating the New York Yankees 7-3 behind Casey Mize's strong performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Rob Refsnyder, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right knee inflammation. The Seattle Mariners' DH will be out for at least 10 days. Other notable injuries include Keegan Akin (Baltimore Orioles), Matt Shaw (Chicago Cubs), Ethan Roberts (Chicago Cubs), Jacob Wilson (Athletics), Tyler Soderstrom (Athletics), Anthony Banda (Minnesota Twins), and David Morgan (San Diego Padres).

The Seattle Mariners made a significant roster move, acquiring first baseman Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Hayden Juenger from the Toronto Blue Jays for catcher Owen Carapellotti. Additionally, the Chicago Cubs acquired left-hander David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for third baseman Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Orioles 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured an 8-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Grant Taylor earning the win.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 11-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, with a final score of 11-7. Brandon Marsh led the Phillies' offense with 2 home runs and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 7-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Casey Mize earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 10 strikeouts and no earned runs. Amed Rosario led the Tigers' offense with a home run, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Mets Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, unable to overcome a strong performance from the Blue Jays' pitching staff. Francisco Lindor led the Mets' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Refsnyder Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Seattle Mariners DH Rob Refsnyder has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right knee inflammation, effective retroactive to June 27, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired in a trade with the San Francisco Giants for cash. Kennedy joins the Mariners in a move that brings new depth to the team's lineup.
